mapper.select: SELECT tCodModel.*, tCodConstrVal.ConstrValDesc AS DomainName FROM tCodModel, tCodConstrVal WHERE tCodModel.domainCode = tCodConstrVal.constrVal AND tCodConstrVal.constrCode = 'cDomainType' AND ModelId = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tCodModel (SystemCode, DomainCode, KorWord1, KorWord2, KorWord3, KorWord4, KorWord5, EngAbbr1, EngAbbr2, EngAbbr3, EngAbbr4, EngAbbr5, AlterName, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName) VALUES (#{systemCode}, #{domainCode}, #{korWord1}, #{korWord2}, #{korWord3}, #{korWord4}, #{korWord5}, #{engAbbr1}, #{engAbbr2}, #{engAbbr3}, #{engAbbr4}, #{engAbbr5}, #{alterName}, #{state}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{registId}, #{registName})
mapper.update: UPDATE tCodModel SET EngAbbr1 = #{engAbbr}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE KorWord1 = #{korWord}
UPDATE tCodModel SET EngAbbr2 = #{engAbbr}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE KorWord2 = #{korWord}
UPDATE tCodModel SET EngAbbr3 = #{engAbbr}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE KorWord3 = #{korWord}
UPDATE tCodModel SET EngAbbr4 = #{engAbbr}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE KorWord4 = #{korWord}
UPDATE tCodModel SET EngAbbr5 = #{engAbbr}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE KorWord5 = #{korWord}
